---
name: Enhancement or validation task
about: Propose a bounded compiler, validation, testing or documentation change
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem and desired behavior

What concrete user/configuration case motivates this change?

## Scope and non-goals

Identify the affected stage or document. Keep one reviewable concern per issue.

## Existing contracts and dependencies

Link related issues/PRs; check for duplicates and circular prerequisites.
List decisions that must be agreed first, including schema/IR/grammar alignment
or a new dependency. Mark unsettled designs proposed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable behavior or document deliverable specified.
- [ ] Required positive/negative examples and diagnostic expectations specified.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility implications recorded.

## Verification

Describe valid/invalid fixtures, cross-format pairs, platform checks or a
documentation review as appropriate. Avoid requesting compiler features that
are outside the agreed scope.
